arabic_text: وَنَجِّنَا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ كَرْب يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَشَدَائِدِ أَهْوَالِ يَوْمِ الطَّامَّةِ
transliteration: wa-najjinā bihī min kulli karbin yawm al-qiyāmah wa shada'idih ahwali yawmi al-tammati
english_text: and deliver us from every distress on the Day of Resurrection and from the hardships of terrors on the Day of Disaster!

arabic_text: وَبَيِّضْ وُجُوهَنَا يَوْمَ تَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهُ الظَّلَمَةِ فِي يَوْمِ الْحَسْرَةِ وَالنَّدَامَةِ، وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي صُدُورِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وُدّاً، وَلاَ تَجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ عَلَيْنَا نَكَداً.
transliteration: wa bayyid wujuhna yawma taswaddu wujuhu al-thalama fī yawm al-ḥasraẗi wa al-nadāmaẗi wajʿal lana fī ṣudūr al-muʾminīn wuddan walā tajʿalil-ḥayāh ʿalaynā nakadāً
english_text: Whiten our faces on the day when the faces of wrongdoers are blackened during the Day of Regret and Remorse, appoint love for us in the breasts of the faithful, and make not life for us troublesome!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ كَمَا بَلَّغَ رِسَالَتَكَ، وَصَدَعَ بِأَمْرِكَ، وَنَصَحَ لِعِبَادِكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad ʿabdika wa rasūlika ka-mā bal-lagha risālata-ka, wa-ṣaḍaʿa bi-am-rika, wa-naṣaḥa li-ʿibad-
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad, Thy servant and Thy messenger, just as He delivered Thy message, executed Thy command, and counselled Thy servants!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ نَبِيَّنا صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَقْرَبَ النِّبِيِّينَ مِنْكَ مَجْلِساً، وَأَمْكَنَهُمْ مِنْكَ شَفَاعَةً، وَأَجَلَّهُمْ عِنْدَكَ قَدْراً، وَأَوْجَهَهُمْ عِنْدَكَ جَاهَاً.
transliteration: allāhumma ijʿal nabīyanā ṣalawātuka ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ʾālihī yawm al-qiyāmah aqraba al-nnabīyyīna minka majlisāً wa'amkanahum minka shafa'atan, wa'ajallahum 'indaka qadran wa-aʾwjahahum ʿindaka jahāً
english_text: O God, make our Prophet (Thy blessings be upon him and his Household) on the Day of Resurrection the nearest of the prophets to Thee in seat, the ablest of them before Thee with intercession, the greatest of them with Thee in measure, and the most eminent of them with Thee in rank!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد وَشَرِّفْ بُنْيَانَهُ، وَعَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهُ، وَثَقِّلْ مِيزَانَهُ، وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ وَقَرِّبْ وَسِيلَتَهُ، وَبَيِّضْ وَجْهَهُ، وَأَتِمَّ نُورَهُ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa shar rif bunyānah waʿaẓẓim burhānahu, wa thaqqil mīzānahu wa taqabbal shafāʿatahu wa qarrib wasīlatahu wa bayyid wajhahu, wa atimm nūrah
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, ennoble his edifice, magnify his proof, make weighty his balance, accept his intercession, bring near his mediation, whiten his face, complete his light,

arabic_text: وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ، وَأَحْيِنَا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَخُذْ بِنَـا مِنْهَاجَـهُ، وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا سَبِيلَهُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ،
transliteration: wa-arfaʿ darajatahu, wa-ahyina ʿala sunnatihi wa tawaffana ʿala millatihi, wa khudh bina minhajih wa-asluk bina sabee-lahu, wa-aj'alna min ahli ta'atih wa'aḥshurnā fī zumratihī
english_text: and raise his degree! Make us live according to his Sunna make us die in his creed, take us on his road, make us travel his path, place us among the people who obey him, muster us in his band,

transliteration: wa awridnā ḥawdahu, wa asqinā bi ka'sihi
english_text: lead us to up his pool, and give us to drink of his cup!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاةً تُبَلِّغُهُ بِهَا أَفْضَلَ مَا يَأْمُلُ مِنْ خَيْرِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ṣalātan tuballighuhā bihā afḍala ma ya'mul min khayrik wa fadlik wa karamatik
english_text: And bless Muhammad and his Household, with a blessing through which Thou wilt take him to the most excellent of what He hopes of Thy good, Thy bounty, and Thy generosity!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ ذُوْ رَحْمَة وَاسِعَة وَفَضْل كَرِيم.
transliteration: ʾinnaka dhū raḥmatin wāsiʿah wa faḍlun karīm
english_text: Thou art Possessor of boundless mercy and generous bounty.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اجْزِهِ بِمَا بَلَّغَ مِنْ رِسَالاتِكَ وَأَدَّى مِنْ آيَاتِكَ وَنَصَحَ لِعِبَادِكَ وَجَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَزَيْتَ أَحَداً مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ajzihī bimā ballagh min risālātika wa adda min ayatika wa nasaḥa li'ibadika wa jāhada fī sabīlika afḍala mā jazayta aḥadan min malāʾikatika almuqarrabīna wa anbiyāʾika al-mursalīna almuṣṭafayna
english_text: O God, repay him for Thy messages which he delivered, Thy signs which he passed on, the good counsel he gave to Thy servants, and the struggle he undertook in Thy way, with the best Thou hast repaid any of Thy angels brought nigh and Thy prophets sent out and chosen!

arabic_text: وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَرَحْمَةُ الله وَبَرَكَاتُهُ.
transliteration: wa al-salāmu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih al-ṭayyibīn al-ṭāhirīn wa raḥmatu allāhi wa barakātuhu
english_text: And upon him and his Household, the good, the pure, be peace, God's mercy, and His blessings!
